title: Optimal Financial Depth and the Financial Possibility Frontier
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Optimal Financial Depth and the Financial Possibility Frontier
detail.abstract: This paper develops a parsimonious framework that links the Financial Possibility Frontier (FPF) to a welfare-based notion of “Goldilocks” financial depth. Financial depth is measured by leverage (credit-to-GDP) and constrained by a reduced-form solvency technology that maps leverage and structural fundamentals into systemic crisis probability under a prudential solvency standard. The framework defines the FPF as the maximum sustainable leverage consistent with the solvency requirement and distinguishes it from a structural depth line under weak institutions, yielding an institutional premium in sustainable depth. Embedding the frontier constraint in a welfare problem that trades off diminishing intermediation benefits against convex fragility costs delivers a unique interior “Goldilocks” level of financial depth that lies strictly below the frontier. Comparative statics characterize how the welfare-optimal depth and distance to the frontier vary with fundamentals, institutional quality, and prudential standards.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个简约框架，将金融可能性边界（FPF）与基于福利的"恰到好处"金融深度概念联系起来。该框架通过杠杆率（信贷/GDP）衡量金融深度，并受限于一个简化形式的偿付能力技术，该技术将杠杆率和结构基本面映射到审慎偿付标准下的系统性危机概率。框架定义了FPF作为符合偿付要求的最大可持续杠杆率，并将其与弱制度下的结构深度线区分开来，从而产生可持续深度的制度溢价。将边界约束嵌入权衡中介收益递减与脆弱性成本凸性的福利问题中，得出一个严格低于边界的独特内部"恰到好处"金融深度水平。
AI.research_question: 如何确定福利最优的金融深度水平？金融可能性边界与最优金融深度之间的关系是什么？制度质量、基本面和审慎标准如何影响福利最优的金融深度及其与边界的距离？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏一个将金融可能性边界与福利最优金融深度联系起来的统一框架。需要理解在考虑系统性危机风险和制度约束的情况下，什么水平的金融深度对经济最有利，而不是简单地追求最大可能的金融深度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融可能性边界（FPF）理论、偿付能力技术、系统性危机概率模型、福利经济学框架（权衡金融中介收益与脆弱性成本）、制度经济学（制度质量对金融深度的约束）。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：开发简约分析框架，将杠杆率作为金融深度的度量，建立偿付能力技术函数，将杠杆率和结构基本面映射到危机概率。在福利最大化问题中嵌入FPF约束，进行数学推导和比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 1. 金融可能性边界（FPF）是符合偿付要求的最大可持续杠杆率；2. 弱制度下存在结构深度线，与FPF之间存在制度溢价；3. 福利最优的"恰到好处"金融深度严格低于FPF；4. 制度质量、基本面和审慎标准的变化会影响最优深度及其与边界的距离。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了连接金融可能性边界与福利最优金融深度的统一理论框架；2. 区分了最大可持续深度（FPF）与福利最优深度；3. 提出了"制度溢价"概念，量化制度质量对可持续金融深度的影响；4. 提供了系统性危机风险与金融深度权衡的正式模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了确定最优金融深度的分析工具；2. 强调了制度质量在金融发展中的关键作用；3. 为审慎监管标准的设计提供了理论依据；4. 帮助理解金融深化与金融稳定之间的权衡关系。

title: Oil Price Volatility, Firm Risk Exposure, and Debt Market Segmentation

detail.title: Oil Price Volatility, Firm Risk Exposure, and Debt Market Segmentation
detail.abstract: This research evaluates the impact of the Oil prices volatility (OPV) relates to the selection of company debt. By analyzing a large dataset of enterprises from 72 nations (excluding the US), We show that heightened oil price volatility significantly affects firms’ capital structure decisions, increasing their tendency to rely on private borrowing instead of government debt. This debt decision is affected differently by the inequality (between up and down volatilities) and the varied origins (supply & demand shocks) of oil price volatility. Also, private borrowing is more popular among oil consumers and replacement companies than among oil producers themselves. For companies based in countries with different legal systems, those vulnerable to regulatory lawsuits, and those that need greater capital investment and more robust reward distribution, the link is stronger. Mitigates the detrimental effects of competitive markets and global board changes on personal debt decisions. Our supplemental data show that the volatility of oil prices is positively correlated with the volatility of businesses' revenues and returns on investment. These factors moderate the effects observed in our main findings, and suggests that oil price volatility may add to the business's performance volatility. This research provides additional support for our primary results, helping elucidate the processes by which volatility in oil prices affects business behavior by showing the relationship between oil price fluctuations and the volatility of critical financial measures.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了油价波动对企业债务选择的影响。通过对72个国家（除美国外）企业的大数据分析，发现油价波动加剧会使企业更倾向于选择私人借贷而非政府债务，这种影响因油价波动的方向不对称性（上涨与下跌）和来源（供给与需求冲击）而异。油价波动通过增加企业收入和投资回报的波动性来影响企业行为。
AI.research_question: 油价波动如何影响企业的资本结构决策，特别是私人借贷与政府债务的选择？
AI.motivation: 油价波动是全球经济中的重要不确定性因素，但现有研究较少关注其对微观企业层面债务决策的具体影响机制，特别是不同类型债务的选择问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本结构理论、不确定性下的企业决策理论，以及油价波动对企业风险暴露的差异化影响框架。
AI.method: 使用72个国家（除美国外）企业的大规模面板数据，采用计量经济学方法分析油价波动与企业债务选择的关系，并考虑油价波动的不对称性和来源差异。
AI.findings: 1. 油价波动加剧使企业更倾向于选择私人借贷而非政府债务；2. 这种影响因油价波动的方向（上涨vs下跌）和来源（供给vs需求冲击）而异；3. 油价消费者和替代能源企业比石油生产商更倾向于私人借贷；4. 在法律体系不同、易受监管诉讼、需要更多资本投资和更强奖励分配的企业中，这种关系更强；5. 油价波动与企业收入和投资回报的波动性正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了油价波动对企业微观决策影响的理论框架；2. 揭示了油价波动通过影响企业绩效波动性来影响债务选择的机制；3. 提供了油价波动不对称性和来源差异对企业决策影响的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者在油价波动环境下的债务决策提供指导；2. 为金融机构评估企业风险提供新视角；3. 为政策制定者理解油价波动对实体经济的影响提供实证依据。

title: AI as a Test of Organizational Design
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: AI as a Test of Organizational Design
detail.abstract: Most artificial intelligence (AI) transformations do not fail because the technology is flawed. They fail because organizations redesign skills—not decision systems. As AI becomes embedded in everyday workflows, training programs expand and certifications multiply, yet authority structures, accountability routines, and performance architectures often remain unchanged. A widening design gap emerges. AI does not merely automate tasks; it institutionalizes persistent uncertainty through probabilistic outputs, adaptive models, and distributed discretion. When uncertainty becomes routine rather than exceptional, traditional hierarchies and outcome-based accountability systems begin to fracture. Without structural redesign, organizations drift into three predictable traps: performative automation, platform dependence, and certification without governance change. This article argues that the central leadership challenge of AI is not adoption but design. It introduces decision capacity—the organizational ability to ensure that AI-mediated decisions remain attributable, contestable, revisable, and, when necessary, stoppable. The paper outlines four concrete design moves and a diagnostic framework leaders can use to determine whether their AI initiatives are producing surface modernization or durable governance capacity. AI will not fix weak decision systems. It will expose them. Organizations that understand this shift can transform not only how they use technology, but how they govern decisions in an era of persistent uncertainty.

AI.tldr: AI转型失败通常不是因为技术问题，而是因为组织只重新设计技能而非决策系统。本文提出"决策能力"概念，强调AI时代需要重新设计组织结构来应对持续不确定性，避免陷入表面现代化陷阱。
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，组织如何重新设计决策系统来应对持续不确定性，避免表面现代化陷阱？
AI.motivation: 大多数AI转型失败不是因为技术缺陷，而是因为组织只关注技能培训而忽视了决策系统的结构性改革，导致设计差距扩大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策能力理论（Decision Capacity） - 组织确保AI中介决策保持可归因、可争议、可修订且在必要时可停止的能力。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，提出四种具体设计行动和诊断框架，帮助领导者评估AI倡议是产生表面现代化还是持久的治理能力。
AI.findings: AI不会修复薄弱的决策系统，反而会暴露它们。组织若缺乏结构性重新设计，会陷入三种可预测的陷阱：表演性自动化、平台依赖和无治理变革的认证。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"决策能力"作为AI时代组织设计的核心概念
2. 识别AI带来的持续不确定性对传统层级和问责系统的挑战
3. 构建AI转型的设计差距理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供四种具体设计行动帮助组织重新设计决策系统
2. 开发诊断框架评估AI倡议的治理效果
3. 帮助领导者区分表面现代化与持久治理能力建设

title: Dual-Driven and Value Symbiosis: Research on Egoism-Altruism Synergy Mechanism of University students’ Entrepreneurial Motivation

detail.title: Dual-Driven and Value Symbiosis: Research on Egoism-Altruism Synergy Mechanism of University students’ Entrepreneurial Motivation
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurial intention among university students is driven by multiple motivational forces, yet limited attention has been paid to the joint effects of egoistic and altruistic motivations and the role of educational context. Grounded in entrepreneurial motivation theory and a dual-driven motivational perspective, this study examines how self-oriented and other-oriented motivations influence students' entrepreneurial intention and preparation behavior. Survey data were collected from 603 university students across multiple universities and analyzed using structural equation modeling. The results reveal an asymmetric motivational pattern: altruistic entrepreneurial motivation is positively associated with entrepreneurial intention, whereas egoistic motivation shows no significant effect. Entrepreneurial intention strongly predicts entrepreneurial preparation behavior, highlighting its central role in translating motivation into early-stage action. Moreover, entrepreneurship education selectively strengthens the positive relationship between altruistic motivation and entrepreneurial intention, while no moderating effect is found for egoistic motivation. These findings advance understanding of the differentiated and context-dependent effects of entrepreneurial motivations and offer practical implications for entrepreneurship education aimed at fostering socially responsible and sustainable entrepreneurial engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于创业动机理论和双驱动视角，探讨自我导向和他人导向动机对大学生创业意向和准备行为的影响。研究发现利他创业动机正向影响创业意向，而利己动机无显著影响；创业教育强化了利他动机与创业意向的关系。
AI.research_question: 自我导向（利己）和他人导向（利他）动机如何影响大学生的创业意向和准备行为？创业教育在其中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对创业动机的联合效应关注不足，特别是利己和利他动机的交互作用，以及教育情境在其中扮演的角色。需要更深入地理解不同动机类型如何影响创业意向和行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业动机理论、双驱动动机视角（自我导向vs他人导向动机）
AI.method: 问卷调查法，收集603名来自多所大学的学生数据，使用结构方程模型进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 利他创业动机正向影响创业意向，利己动机无显著影响；2. 创业意向强烈预测创业准备行为；3. 创业教育强化利他动机与创业意向的正向关系，但对利己动机无调节作用
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了创业动机的不对称模式；2. 阐明了创业意向在动机转化为行为中的核心作用；3. 证明了创业教育对动机影响的差异化调节效应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创业教育提供实践指导，强调培养社会责任感和可持续创业；2. 帮助教育者设计更有效的课程，强化利他动机的作用；3. 促进社会导向型创业活动的发展

title: Data Vulnerability & Privacy Literacy in FinTech Application Usage: An extended APBO framework
affiliations: Vellore Institute of Technology and Vellore Institute of Technology

detail.title: Data Vulnerability & Privacy Literacy in FinTech Application Usage: An extended APBO framework
detail.abstract: This study extends the APBO framework by exploring how data vulnerability influences privacy literacy through privacy concern and protective behaviour pathways with trustworthiness as a moderator. Grounded in Privacy Calculus Theory, we hypothesised that data vulnerability drives both privacy concern and literacy, with concern triggering protective behaviours that enhance literacy. Additionally, trustworthiness moderates vulnerability concern dynamics. We surveyed 350 fintech users using 33 validated Likert-scale items measuring five constructs. We used PLS-SEM with 5,000 bootstrap resamples, tested direct effects and moderated mediation. Data vulnerability significantly predicted privacy concern and literacy. Privacy concern predicted protection behaviour, which anticipated literacy. Critically, trustworthiness moderated the vulnerability concern pathway, amplifying protective response rather than dampening it. Conditional indirect effects rose from low trust to high trust in the DV→PC→PPB string. Findings reveal that data vulnerability catalyses adaptive coping behaviours building privacy literacy through protective engagement. Platform trustworthiness enhances vulnerability salience, driving stronger protective action. Fintech providers should embed privacy literacy into platform design and transparent data communication rather than treating it as isolated education. This research contributes to Privacy Calculus Theory by evidencing vulnerability driven literacy development in fintech contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究扩展了APBO框架，探讨数据脆弱性如何通过隐私关注和保护行为路径影响隐私素养，并以可信度作为调节变量。基于隐私计算理论，研究发现数据脆弱性显著预测隐私关注和素养，隐私关注触发保护行为进而提升素养，平台可信度增强脆弱性对关注的效应，从而强化保护行为。
AI.research_question: 数据脆弱性如何通过隐私关注和保护行为路径影响隐私素养，以及平台可信度如何调节这一过程？
AI.motivation: 扩展APBO框架，理解在金融科技环境中数据脆弱性如何驱动隐私素养发展，为平台设计提供实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐私计算理论（Privacy Calculus Theory），APBO框架扩展
AI.method: 对350名金融科技用户进行问卷调查，使用33个经过验证的Likert量表项目测量五个构念，采用PLS-SEM方法，5000次bootstrap重抽样，检验直接效应和调节中介效应
AI.findings: 1. 数据脆弱性显著预测隐私关注和隐私素养；2. 隐私关注预测保护行为，保护行为预测隐私素养；3. 平台可信度调节脆弱性-关注路径，增强而非减弱保护反应；4. 条件间接效应从低可信度到高可信度在DV→PC→PPB路径中上升
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展隐私计算理论，证明在金融科技环境中数据脆弱性驱动的素养发展机制，揭示可信度作为增强而非减弱脆弱性效应的调节变量
AI.practical_contributions: 金融科技提供商应将隐私素养嵌入平台设计和透明的数据沟通中，而非作为孤立的教育内容；平台可信度增强脆弱性感知，驱动更强的保护行为

title: Rollover Crises in Calvo’s Model of Sovereign Default(And How to Prevent Them)
affiliations: Vanderbilt University and University of San Diego

detail.title: Rollover Crises in Calvo’s Model of Sovereign Default(And How to Prevent Them)
detail.abstract: In its canonical interpretation, Calvo (1988) describes a sovereign debt crisis in which deterio-rating financing costs and rising debt levels feed back into each other in a self-fulfilling manner.By re-examining the original Calvo model through a decision-theoretic lens, we find that it alsoserves as a natural device to study crises in which the auction fails altogether (i.e. rollovercrises). By considering solution concepts other than Nash equilibrium, our analysis not onlyprovides a novel, non-self-fulfilling narrative of sovereign default, but it also inspires two simplelevers to prevent such default.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视Calvo(1988)主权债务危机模型，通过决策理论视角发现该模型也可用于研究拍卖完全失败的展期危机。通过考虑纳什均衡之外的其他解概念，为主权违约提供了非自我实现的新解释，并提出了两个简单的违约预防机制。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重新解释Calvo(1988)模型来研究主权债务展期危机，并提供非自我实现的主权违约解释？
AI.motivation: 传统Calvo模型主要关注自我实现的债务危机，但现实中存在拍卖完全失败的展期危机，需要新的理论框架来解释和预防这类危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: Calvo(1988)主权债务危机模型、决策理论、博弈论解概念（超越纳什均衡）
AI.method: 理论模型分析，重新审视Calvo原始模型，采用决策理论视角，考虑纳什均衡之外的其他解概念
AI.findings: Calvo模型不仅可解释自我实现的债务危机，也可作为研究拍卖完全失败的展期危机的自然工具；通过不同解概念的分析，提供了主权违约的非自我实现解释
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展Calvo模型的应用范围，从自我实现危机到展期危机；2) 为主权违约提供非自我实现的新理论解释；3) 引入决策理论视角丰富主权债务危机分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了两个简单有效的杠杆来预防主权违约，为政策制定者提供实用工具

title: Using AI And Big Data to Predict Inflation Trends Based on Global Economic Sentiment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of North Alabama

detail.title: Using AI And Big Data to Predict Inflation Trends Based on Global Economic Sentiment
detail.abstract: This study demonstrates how artificial intelligence (AI) and Big Data can improve inflation forecasting by using traditional macroeconomic indicators with real-time sentiment drawn from news and social media. We integrate the Consumer Price Index (CPI) with over 100 000 text records collected between January 2020 and December 2024 from outlets such as Reuters, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, Twitter and Reddit. After tokenization and lemmatization, sentiment scores were extracted using the Vader Sentiment Intensity Analyzer and combined with TF-IDF lexical features. A Random Forest Regressor was selected because of its ability to model complex nonlinear relationships; its performance was benchmarked against a baseline linear regression model. Hyperparameter tuning and five-fold cross-validation yielded an average R² of 0.82 ± 0.03, MAE of 0.35 ± 0.04, and RMSE of 0.48 ± 0.05, outperforming the linear model (R²≈0.60). Residual analysis, including the Durbin-Watson statistic (≈1.90), confirmed minimal autocorrelation. These results suggest that sentiment-enhanced machine learning models provide a more nuanced and timelier picture of inflation dynamics than traditional techniques. The paper further discusses ethical considerations, interpretability via SHAP values, deployment considerations and directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本研究展示了如何利用AI和大数据，通过结合传统宏观经济指标与新闻和社交媒体的实时情绪数据来改进通胀预测。使用随机森林回归器，结合CPI数据和超过10万条文本记录，获得了优于传统线性模型的预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能和大数据技术，通过整合传统宏观经济指标与新闻和社交媒体的实时情绪数据来提高通胀预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀预测方法主要依赖宏观经济指标，但往往忽略了市场情绪和公众感知对通胀动态的影响。随着AI和大数据技术的发展，整合实时文本情绪数据可能提供更及时、更细致的通胀预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和情绪分析理论，认为市场情绪和公众感知会影响通胀预期和实际通胀动态。结合机器学习方法，特别是随机森林算法，用于处理复杂的非线性关系。
AI.method: 收集2020年1月至2024年12月期间超过10万条来自路透社、彭博社、华尔街日报、Twitter和Reddit的文本数据。使用Vader情绪强度分析器提取情绪分数，结合TF-IDF词汇特征。采用随机森林回归器，通过超参数调优和五折交叉验证进行模型评估。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型表现优异：平均R²为0.82±0.03，MAE为0.35±0.04，RMSE为0.48±0.05，显著优于线性回归模型（R²≈0.60）。Durbin-Watson统计量（≈1.90）显示残差自相关性最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合传统宏观经济指标与实时情绪数据的通胀预测理论框架，验证了情绪数据对通胀预测的理论价值，扩展了行为经济学在宏观经济预测中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了基于情绪增强的机器学习通胀预测模型，为政策制定者和金融机构提供了更准确、更及时的通胀预测工具。讨论了伦理考量、SHAP值可解释性、部署考虑和未来研究方向。

title: Why Are Healthcare Top Managers Cynical?  The Effects of Feeling Powerless, Role Overload, and Resilience
affiliations: Dublin City University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Dublin City University, HEC Montreal - Department of Human Resources Management and HEC Montreal

detail.title: Why Are Healthcare Top Managers Cynical?  The Effects of Feeling Powerless, Role Overload, and Resilience
detail.abstract: Background Sense of power is a vital leadership resource for managing job demands and sustaining organisational effectiveness in healthcare. However, Top Management Healthcare Professionals (TMHPs) may perceive a lack of power despite holding positional power, leaving them vulnerable to stress and disengagement. Such strain may manifest as cynicism, a negative and withdrawn attitude toward work that undermines professional wellbeing and patient care. Purpose Building on the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) model, we examine whether Sense of Powerlessness (SOP) leads to higher perceptions of Role Overload (RO) and subsequently higher cynicism among TMHPs, with these relationships less pronounced for TMHPs with high levels of resilience. Design/methodology/approach Data from 165 TMHPs were analysed using regression to test direct, indirect, and moderated effects of SOP, RO, and resilience on cynicism. Results SOP positively impacts RO, which in turn heightens cynicism. Resilience weakens the positive impact of RO on cynicism and reduces the indirect effect of SOP on cynicism through RO. Conclusion SOP positively affects cynicism among TMHPs, primarily through heightened RO. Resilience buffers this effect, highlighting the importance of personal resources in mitigating the impact of demanding roles in healthcare leadership. Practical Implications Interventions that strengthen resilience and manage RO may reduce cynicism amongst TMHPs. Organisations should consider targeted training, workload redistribution, and effective leadership.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于工作要求-资源模型，探讨医疗高管权力感缺失如何通过角色超载导致犬儒主义，以及韧性如何缓冲这一负面效应。
AI.research_question: 医疗高管权力感缺失是否通过角色超载导致犬儒主义？韧性如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 医疗高管虽拥有职位权力，但可能感知权力缺失，导致压力、疏离和犬儒主义，影响专业福祉和患者护理质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作要求-资源模型，探讨权力感缺失作为压力源，角色超载作为工作要求，韧性作为个人资源的作用机制。
AI.method: 对165名医疗高管进行问卷调查，使用回归分析检验权力感缺失、角色超载和韧性对犬儒主义的直接、间接和调节效应。
AI.findings: 权力感缺失正向影响角色超载，进而增强犬儒主义；韧性减弱角色超载对犬儒主义的正向影响，并降低权力感缺失通过角色超载对犬儒主义的间接效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展JD-R模型在医疗领导力背景下的应用，揭示权力感缺失作为独特压力源的作用机制，阐明韧性作为个人资源的缓冲作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议通过增强韧性训练、合理分配工作负荷和有效领导力发展来减少医疗高管的犬儒主义，提升组织效能和患者护理质量。

title: The Role of Cultural Identity in Financial Risk Perception: An Indian Perspective Across Borders
affiliations: Mahatma Gandhi University, Banasthali University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Role of Cultural Identity in Financial Risk Perception: An Indian Perspective Across Borders
detail.abstract: Abstract Using the Indian expatriate community as the primary focal point, this paper explores how cultural identity is a catalyst to financial risk perception, particularly those residing the United Arab Emirates. The study draws cross disciplinary perspectives and argues the deeply embedded cultural values, societal norms and collective memories are underlying currents deciding one’s behavior and attitude towards financial risk. Though globalization is the root of such influences the investment behavior, core cultural scripts continue to shape and mold financial decision-making processes hence calling for a culturally aware and inclusive financial frameworks even in the present modern world.The study combines quantitative data collection through comprehensive surveys collected from 500 respondents along with structured interviews for qualitative data.Advanced statistical techniques were utilized to identify and analyze significant differences in risk attitudes between Indian residents and expatriates. The findings underscore the pivotal role of cultural adaptation and financial socialization in shaping individuals' risk preferences. Specifically, Indian expatriates in the UAE exhibit distinct risk behaviors compared to their counterparts in India. These insights offer valuable implications for policymakers, financial advisors, and investors, highlighting the need for tailored financial education programs and culturally sensitive investment strategies. However, the study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and the cross-sectional design. Future research should consider longitudinal studies to better understand the dynamics of cultural adaptation and financial risk perception over time.

AI.tldr: 本文以印度侨民群体为主要研究对象，探讨文化身份如何影响金融风险感知，特别是在阿联酋的印度侨民。研究发现文化价值观、社会规范和集体记忆是决定个人金融风险态度和行为的基础因素，即使在全球化背景下，核心文化脚本仍持续塑造金融决策过程。
AI.research_question: 文化身份如何作为金融风险感知的催化剂，特别是在阿联酋的印度侨民群体中？
AI.motivation: 全球化背景下，虽然金融体系日益融合，但文化因素对金融决策的影响仍然显著。研究旨在理解文化价值观、社会规范和集体记忆如何塑造个人的金融风险态度和行为，特别是在跨文化环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化认同理论、金融社会化理论、文化适应理论、风险感知理论。研究认为深层次的文化价值观、社会规范和集体记忆是决定个人金融风险态度和行为的基础因素。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定量数据通过500份综合问卷调查收集，定性数据通过结构化访谈获取。使用高级统计技术分析印度居民与侨民之间风险态度的显著差异。
AI.findings: 1. 文化适应和金融社会化在塑造个人风险偏好中起关键作用；2. 阿联酋的印度侨民表现出与印度本土居民不同的风险行为；3. 核心文化脚本持续塑造金融决策过程，即使在全球化背景下。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对文化身份与金融风险感知关系的理解；2. 验证了文化适应理论在金融决策领域的适用性；3. 为跨文化金融行为研究提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者、金融顾问和投资者提供重要启示；2. 强调需要制定量身定制的金融教育计划；3. 倡导文化敏感的投资策略和包容性金融框架。
